title: 013 - Running Total
prompt: Fix the bug so the program sum all numbers in the sample list and print 30 and prints exactly `30`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
def running_total(score):
    return "PASS" if score > 40 else "FAIL"
solutionCode:
def running_total(score):
    return "PASS" if score >= 40 else "FAIL"
hint: The accumulator should not restart inside the loop.
explanation: The total is reset during each iteration. Keeping the accumulator outside the loop gives the full sum.
